content: January 16, 2025 Español Preventing Cancer What to know You can lower your risk of getting many common kinds of cancer. Overview You can lower your risk of getting many common kinds of cancer by making healthy choices. Screening tests can find some cancers early, when treatment works best. Vaccines (shots) can help prevent several kinds of cancer. Learn more about how to lower your risk of getting cancer. How to prevent cancer or find it early Cancer Screening Tests Screening tests can find several types of cancer early.
